function.name: get_error_monitoring_overview
function.description: Get the current site's complete error analytics summary, including trends, affected users, error types, and high-frequency errors. The inclusive date range defaults to the current analytics week.

top.description: Maximum number of entries returned for each ranking or distribution. Default 20, maximum 200.

includeDimensions.description: Include the native aggregated dimensions in addition to the named report fields.

startDate.description: Inclusive analytics date in yyyy-MM-dd format. Defaults to Monday of the current analytics week.

endDate.description: Inclusive analytics date in yyyy-MM-dd format. Defaults to the current analytics day.
